# galaxie

> A browser-first agent runtime for reviewed, bundled agents, with host-owned capabilities, model routing and UI. Code is Apache-2.0; outside contributions need a DCO sign-off.

## Start here

- [Project brief](docs/galaxie-project-brief.md): scope and architecture.
- [Project status](docs/status.md): implemented behavior, mock-only verification and unmeasured paths.
- [System design](docs/system-design.md): implemented contracts and limits.
- [Root coding guidance](AGENTS.md): repository rules.
- [License](LICENSE): Apache-2.0, with a [NOTICE](NOTICE) file.
- [Framework overview](docs/framework-overview.md): audiences and direction; distinguish targets from implemented contracts.
- [Architecture decisions](docs/adr/README.md): statuses and decision index; follow Accepted decisions.
- [Security review](docs/security-review.md): SDK controls, host duties, evidence and residual risks.

## Host guides and device evidence

- [MVP exit record](docs/mvp-exit-record.md): AT-01 through AT-36 evidence, gaps and decision inputs; the maintainer's Go decision (2026-10-30) is recorded with its open items still open.
- [Unsupported features](docs/unsupported.md): current exclusions, implementation limits and unverified paths.
- [Host integration](docs/guides/host-integration.md): Layer 0 runs an agent in memory; Layer 1 adds persistence, recovery and ownership; Layer 2 adds hardening, with detailed host references.
- [Development tracing](docs/guides/tracing.md): filtered spans and a host-run collector; no tracing secrets in the browser.
- [Device matrix](docs/device-matrix.md): automated mock/fake coverage and limited real-device demonstrations.
- [M2 exit record](docs/m2-exit-record.md): real local models on one Apple M5 Pro with Chrome 155.
- [M3 exit record](docs/m3-exit-record.md): reload, duplicates, handover and logout on that device.

## Package introductions

- [Core README](packages/core/README.md): framework-neutral contracts and host runtime setup.
- [UI protocol README](packages/ui-protocol/README.md): pure A2UI parsing, catalog validation and surface reduction; no core/React integration yet.
- [Adapter kit README](packages/adapter-kit/README.md): shared internal adapter helpers, public-root imports and no standalone API stability promise.
- [LangGraph adapter README](packages/adapter-langgraph/README.md): a minimal graph and explicit config.
- [Python adapter README](packages/adapter-pyodide/README.md): trusted LangGraph Python/pydantic-ai/DSPy Workers, checked bridge, durable interactions, deterministic DSPy replay and JavaScript policy.
- [ADK adapter README](packages/adapter-adk/README.md): `adk-js` executor over the ADK 2.3.0 browser bundle: router-backed models, capability tools, checked streaming, confirmations and long-running tools as interactions, durable sessions and the supported agent shapes.
- ADK Python: the `adk-python` executor lives in the [Python adapter README](packages/adapter-pyodide/README.md#google-adk-python-agents) ([ADR-0022](docs/adr/0022-google-adk-python-through-the-pyodide-adapter.md), Proposed): authoring surface, supported agent shapes and third-party licenses.
- ADK Go: the `adk-go` executor lives in the [Go adapter README](packages/adapter-go/README.md) ([ADR-0023](docs/adr/0023-google-adk-go-through-a-wasm-worker.md), Proposed): authoring surface, supported agent shapes, build command and third-party licenses; the [Go module](go/README.md) holds the sources.
- [Models README](packages/models/README.md): provider subpaths, the deterministic mock and the ONNX (Transformers.js) provider's host wiring.
- [React README](packages/react/README.md): surfaces and separate host confirmations.
- [IndexedDB README](packages/storage-indexeddb/README.md): scoped checkpoints, recovery and storage lifecycle.
- [MCP tools README](packages/tools-mcp/README.md): pinned host-controlled tool bindings and limits.
- [ESLint plugin README](packages/eslint-plugin/README.md): five agent lint rules and their limits.

## Package coding guidance

- [Core AGENTS](packages/core/AGENTS.md): lifecycle, policy and content-free instrumentation rules.
- [UI protocol AGENTS](packages/ui-protocol/AGENTS.md): pinned protocol, atomic candidates and dependency-free validation.
- [Adapter kit AGENTS](packages/adapter-kit/AGENTS.md): pure shared helpers, erased framework types and preserved adapter boundaries.
- [LangGraph adapter AGENTS](packages/adapter-langgraph/AGENTS.md): native semantics, config and unsupported interrupts.
- [Python adapter AGENTS](packages/adapter-pyodide/AGENTS.md): Worker lifecycle, compiled wheel hashes, CSP and Python trust limits.
- [Go adapter AGENTS](packages/adapter-go/AGENTS.md): module verification before compile, the bridge, the stored record and the agent-shape rules.
- [ADK adapter AGENTS](packages/adapter-adk/AGENTS.md): import rules, bundle pin, host ordering and limits of the ADK executor.
- [Models AGENTS](packages/models/AGENTS.md): host registration and fake-only automated model tests.
- [React AGENTS](packages/react/AGENTS.md): trusted registries, text rendering and host lifecycle.
- [IndexedDB AGENTS](packages/storage-indexeddb/AGENTS.md): principal scope, fencing, recovery and deletion.
- [MCP tools AGENTS](packages/tools-mcp/AGENTS.md): metadata pins, broker dispatch and sanitized errors.
- [ESLint plugin AGENTS](packages/eslint-plugin/AGENTS.md): scope analysis without runtime enforcement.

- [Browser-built RAG example](examples/rag-browser/README.md): four executors (LangGraph.js, LangGraph Python, mock-only pydantic-ai and DSPy), cited streams, durable passage review, verified files and Orama; DSPy real-model paths unverified.

- [ADK recipe example](examples/adk-recipes/README.md): a scripted JavaScript/Go financial advisor and Python auditor/loan picker, checked text, model destinations, durable approval and explicit finalization; synthetic fixtures, refused shapes and no real-model result.

- [Local-only starter template](templates/local-only/README.md): copyable Vite + React app with its own agent, available Built-in AI or immediate mock, size-disclosed WebLLM opt-in and pending-question recovery; standalone registry install and template device behavior unverified.
- [Hybrid gateway starter template](templates/hybrid-gateway/README.md): the same one-question agent with a same-origin Node model proxy, server-held prompts, quotas, scoped document search and idempotent note writes; demo authentication and in-memory state only.

## Verification

- [Conformance suite](tests/conformance/README.md): parity lanes, explicit-config rules and protected goldens.
- [Injection corpus](tests/injection-corpus/README.md): 32 synthetic mock-only cases and their limits.
